faq: Can you set up tracking on my existing website?
Yes. The exact setup depends on the website platform, available access and the events you need to measure.
Can you implement Meta Pixel and CAPI?
Yes. Pixel and server-side CAPI can be planned together, including event parameters and deduplication.
Can you create product advertising videos?
Yes. Product ads can include hooks, demonstrations, motion graphics, captions, sound design and CTA structure.
Yes. Monthly support can cover implementation, analytics reviews, creative and campaign measurement.
Can you guarantee sales or ROAS?
No. Results depend on the product, offer, market, creative, landing page, budget and many other factors.
